sentence_stem: If only I had listened to my teacher,
correct_completion: I would have passed the test.
full_sentence: If only I had listened to my teacher, I would have passed the test.
acceptable_variants: I could have passed the test.
I might have passed the test.

options.text: I will listen to my teacher next time.
options.why_wrong: This is a future plan. A regret about the past needs an imagined past result, not a future intention.
'So' shows a real result. 'If only' introduces an unreal situation, so the result must be imagined, not real.

options.text: I would have passed the test.

options.why_wrong: This describes the teacher's feelings and does not complete the unreal past result that 'if only' requires.

grammar_focus: Regrets about the past with 'if only' plus past perfect
explanation: 'If only' plus the past perfect expresses regret about a past situation. The main clause uses 'would have' plus the past participle to show the result that did not happen.
translation: Якби я лише слухав свого вчителя, я б склав тест.
